1.original: Donuhanu has asked that you procure king puffers for Pashenine's rite of passage.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>King puffers can be fished from High Tide Harbor using crimson lugworms as bait.<hex:02100103><hex:02100103>※Minimum collectability rating for this delivery is 47. Delivering items with a rating of 110 or more will earn greater rewards.

2.original: You deliver the king puffers to Donuhanu. Enjoy some Turali fishing until Pashenine returns with his next request.

24.original: Catch king puffers at High Tide Harbor and deliver them to Donuhanu.

49.original: But of course! The answer's obvious, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I can call you <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, can't I?

51.original: To wit, the king puffer! Its bladelike spines are sure to deflate any toad like a defective dirigible.

52.original: I don't pretend to know how Pashenine's magicks work, but so long as the lad needs a fish, we'll deliver him a fish.

53.original: In fact, let's deliver him several! You can never have too many fish─that's the Fish Fancies Donuhanu motto. So on with you, <hex:02080EE905FF056C617373FF046C616403>! Buy yourself some crimson lugworms from Bayside Bevy, and cast your line at High Tide Harbor.

54.original: As soon as you've reined in some kings, hurry back. We can't keep our friend waitin'!

55.original: You may now undertake deliveries for Fish Fancies Donuhanu. By delivering the requested items to Donuhanu and raising yourself in his esteem, you can help him turn a profit on his catch of choice.

56.original: Items with a higher collectability will result in greater rewards upon delivery. Speak to Donuhanu to view the deliveries list.

57.original: The waters of High Tide Harbor are teemin' with king puffers. And they all love crimson lugworms!

58.original: I came to Tuliyollal because I heard you can find anything here. I'm grateful for any help you might be able to provide!

59.original: Beautiful! Pashenine should be tickled to see such spindly spines.

60.original: Flawless! The spines of true monarchy. Pashenine'll no doubt puff with pleasure!

61.original: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Donuhanu's trust.

62.original: Deliver the fish Pashenine needs, and deliver them often to improve the prospects of Fish Fancies Donuhanu!

63.original: Behold the majesty of a king!

64.original: Though don't let his winsome roundness fool you─king puffers are notorious net-wreckers. A menace, dead or alive!

65.original: What an incredible specimen... I've never seen anything like it!

67.original: Of course, lad! These are your fish, to use however you like. You said you're pullin' magicks out of them, right? How's that done, exactly?

68.original: By eating every piece of it─spines and all!

69.original: M-Meanin' no disrespect, but you'd best rethink that notion, lad. You try to eat that fish and it'll gut you from the inside!

70.original: It's the only way I can acquire my magicks. Rest assured, I've come prepared.

71.original: As I mentioned previously, my only grasp of Whalaqee magicks is upon the slippery and scaled. Where the rest of my brethren must master many techniques, I must master many fish.

72.original: The method is simple─I eat a fish in its entirety, and then I can call upon it at any time. Most Whalaqee can only summon a single species, you see.

73.original: The more I eat a particular fish, the stronger our spiritual affinity grows─so I am prepared to consume as much as necessary.

74.original: To this end, I have spent many a moon studying the culinary arts, that I might prepare any and all fish for complete and pleasurable consumption.

76.original: I sell the occasional anchovy for my customers to munch on while they browse my better beauties, but if folks are only lookin' for a feast...

77.original: ...then we make them the fanciest feasts they've ever seen! Pashenine! You've got to teach me how to cook!

78.original: In exchange, me and <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> will find any fish you need for your rite of passage! You'll have more trials to overcome than one spongy old toad, eh?

79.original: Indeed I will! Thank you, Donuhanu─I couldn't ask for a happier arrangement.

80.original: Likewise, my lad! You'll be needin' a kitchen, won't you? Or did you have a place in mind?

81.original: No place in particular, I admit. My only aim was finding a suitable fish─the rest I assumed would fall into place.

82.original: Well, you're welcome to use old Donuhanu's kitchen in the Resplendent Quarter. Nothin' glamorous─but more glamorous than nothin'!

83.original: Your generosity is limitless. Then, without further ado, allow me to prepare these wonderful puffers you have caught me.

84.original: And there you have it! A king puffer soup garnished with deep-fried spines.

86.original: Y-You really ate those spines right up...

87.original: You caught some wonderful specimens. Already I can feel their energies taking root within me.

88.original: I must familiarize myself with new fish before I can use them in battle. If you'll excuse me, I will find some quiet corner in which to do so.

89.original: Of course, of course! May your kings serve you royally!

90.original: Now, I suppose we wait. ...Fancy a quick fish?

91.original: Donuhanu is pleased with your efforts. He now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Friendly Fish Finder<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

92.original: The next quest will be available from Donuhanu upon reaching level 93 as a fisher.
